facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

facts.constraints: Availability unknown: no scarcity. Policy eligibility details not supplied; do not expand policies. Adult supervision remains necessary. These are saved website observations, not a fresh website check.
facts.visual_brief: Same assumed creative for every condition: product-kit photograph on a plain cream background. No image is supplied to the model; do not claim to inspect a photograph.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for parents who want practical reassurance before buying. We have no approved reviews or certifications to quote. Use available product information and support without implying the home becomes child-safe.

variants.primary_text: That coffee-table corner can catch your eye when your child is playing nearby. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge and corner protectors, so you can address those edges as part of your home childproofing. It’s a practical step for a room you use every day. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Edge & Corner Protectors for Home

variants.primary_text: Wall sockets are easy to overlook while you’re thinking through a room. This kit includes socket guards, giving you a way to include sockets in your childproofing plans. And if you want guidance with installation, 1-to-1 installation video support is available. Socket guards are one part of the setup; adult supervision remains necessary.
variants.headline: Socket Guards in a 6-in-1 Kit

variants.primary_text: Your child reaches for the fridge handle while you’re putting groceries away. The Peach Bucket kit includes cabinet and fridge locks, so these doors can be part of your childproofing plan too. It’s a useful option to consider for the kitchen, alongside adult supervision. See the 6-in-1 kit details before you decide.
variants.headline: Cabinet & Fridge Locks in One Kit

internal_notes: The audience is parents seeking practical reassurance before buying. The scenarios are hypothetical, not customer research.

The three angles use supported kit features: edge and corner protectors, socket guards with 1-to-1 installation video support, and cabinet and fridge locks. The copy does not claim the home becomes child-safe.
Offer and guarantee claims are not used. The supplied policy eligibility details are limited, so no added terms are stated.
The supplied visual brief describes an assumed product-kit photo; the copy makes no claims about inspecting an image.
